data.name: ColumnChartsDescription
data.value: Column, bar and stacked charts drawn in SVG: series, axes, grid lines, legend, data labels, tooltip text and the accessible data table.

data.name: ColumnChartsSettingsDescription
data.value: Each setting redraws the chart below.

data.name: ColumnChartsKindDescription
data.value: Side-by-side columns, horizontal bars or columns stacked on each other.

data.name: ColumnChartsLegendDescription
data.value: Shows the name and colour of each series.

data.name: ColumnChartsDataLabelsDescription
data.value: Writes the values of the 2026 series above their points.

data.name: ColumnChartsGridLinesDescription
data.value: Horizontal guides behind the series; the slider sets how many bands they draw.

data.name: ColumnChartsAxisTitlesDescription
data.value: Names the horizontal and the vertical axis.

data.name: ColumnChartsAutoAxisDescription
data.value: The axis takes its bounds from the series, rounded to a round step: no value leaves the plot.

data.name: ColumnChartsAxisMaximumDescription
data.value: Below the stacked total, the columns are clipped at the top of the chart.

data.name: ColumnChartsTickCountDescription
data.value: Number of intervals written on the value axis.

data.name: ColumnChartsDataTableDescription
data.value: Shows the figures under the chart, for those who do not read the drawing.

data.name: ColumnChartsPreviewHint
data.value: Hover a column to read its value.

data.name: ColumnChartsKindsTitle
data.value: The three kinds side by side

data.name: ColumnChartsMaxHeightHint
data.value: A square chart in a wide card is held under a ceiling; MaxHeight lowers it to 20rem and the drawing keeps its proportions.

data.name: LineChartsDescription
data.value: Line, area and stacked area series with their markers, over a category axis, with a legend, a shared tooltip and a range navigator.

data.name: LineChartsSettingsDescription
data.value: Each setting redraws the chart below.

data.name: LineChartsLegendToggle
data.value: Hide a series from the legend

data.name: LineChartsMinWidth
data.value: Keep a readable width on a narrow screen

data.name: LineChartsKindDescription
data.value: A line, a filled area or areas stacked on each other.

data.name: LineChartsMarkersDescription
data.value: A dot on each point; the slider sets its radius. Stacked, only the first series keeps them.

data.name: LineChartsFirstColorDescription
data.value: Rank in the eight-colour chart palette of the first series; the others follow.

data.name: LineChartsLegendDescription
data.value: Shows the name and colour of each series.

data.name: LineChartsDataLabelsDescription
data.value: Writes the values of the filings series above its points.

data.name: LineChartsPreviewHint
data.value: Hover a line or a marker to read its name or value.

data.name: LineChartsMonthlyTitle
data.value: A line and an area with value labels

data.name: LineChartsDailyTitle
data.value: Thirty days with a shared tooltip

data.name: LineChartsBacklogTitle
data.value: Stacked columns and a dashed area

data.name: LineChartsRangeTitle
data.value: Three years and a chosen range

data.name: LineChartsRangeHint
data.value: Move the handles under the chart, with the pointer or the arrow keys, to choose the months it draws.

data.name: PieChartsDescription
data.value: Pie and donut series: shares of a whole, with labels outside the disc, a legend and a data table in option.

data.name: PieChartsSettingsDescription
data.value: Each setting redraws the chart below.

data.name: PieChartsOutsideLabelsDescription
data.value: What is written beside each slice, joined to it by a leader line.

data.name: PieChartsKindDescription
data.value: A full disc or a ring.

data.name: PieChartsDatasetDescription
data.value: Two sample distributions of different lengths.

data.name: PieChartsSliceCountDescription
data.value: Keeps only the first slices of the distribution.

data.name: PieChartsZeroSliceDescription
data.value: A zero value is skipped by the series without shifting the colours of the following slices.

data.name: PieChartsLegendDescription
data.value: Names each slice that is drawn, with its share, in the colour of the slice.

data.name: PieChartsDataTableDescription
data.value: Shows the values and shares under the chart.

data.name: GaugesDescription
data.value: Arc gauge with its scale and value: bounds, colour index and value formatting.

data.name: GaugesSettingsDescription
data.value: Each setting redraws the gauge below.

data.name: GaugesValueDescription
data.value: The value drawn by the arc, between the bounds of the scale.

data.name: GaugesScaleDescription
data.value: Changes the bounds; the value moves back to the middle of the new scale.

data.name: GaugesFormatDescription
data.value: What the text in the middle of the gauge shows.

data.name: GaugesColorDescription
data.value: Rank in the eight-colour chart palette.

data.name: GaugesPreviewHint
data.value: The value is clamped to the scale: the arc never goes past its bounds.
